problem: The prior compiler documented overlap reconciliation but did not require or validate a reconciliation input, so a caller could emit a window containing UIDs already completed, running, pending, or failed in population-gpu-current-r9.
guards: canonical reconciliation path is mandatory before plan-directory creation
population and pricing identities must match the admitted pricing receipt
population-gpu-current-r9 must be present with a 64-hex plan digest
population-gpu-current-r9 is independently fixed to indices [1,10) and plan digest 6bfec342ca9b2eb5b3f8174e2cf9be597d4b540da6615f62cd13bb48a0011ac1
this compiler revision accepts exactly the one retained r9 handoff; any later retained run requires reviewed code
the canonical campaign plan digest is independently recomputed rather than trusted as a claimed string
all nine campaign native-plan references require path plus SHA-256, resolve below the archived campaign root, and have independently recomputed native plan digests
validated historical JSON is staged as opaque byte-pinned evidence so its original run-relative inner paths cannot bind unrelated current-root files
the canonical campaign plan and status snapshot are rehashed, parsed and matched to the run, tasks, indices, observation and disposition counts
every retained source range must have exactly one ordered disposition per canonical UID
completed, running, pending and failed are the only dispositions
all reconciliation source references are SHA-256 verified and staged into every native input closure
any target-window intersection fails before a plan is emitted
queue approval, dispatch, scientific effect and candidate-test claims remain false

independent_source_review.scope: Static source, tests and contracts only; Local software acceptance and runtime behavior remain unjudged.

limitations: A reconciliation snapshot permits plan generation only and does not prove later host liveness.
This compiler revision intentionally handles only the retained r9 handoff; a later retained run must not be squeezed into this schema without source review.
Local must copy and hash the exact campaign plan and observed status evidence, run the current whole software suite, and re-reconcile immediately before any dispatch decision.
The guard prevents duplicate retained UIDs; it does not convert engineering baselines into candidate scientific results.
